{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for missing values
missing_values = trial_df.isnull().sum()

# Check for duplicates
duplicates = trial_df.duplicated().sum()

# Check the distribution of the 'arm' column
arm_distribution = trial_df['arm'].value_counts()

# Check the distribution of 'responded' by arm
response_by_arm = trial_df.groupby('arm')['responded'].value_counts(normalize=True)

# Print results
missing_values, duplicates, arm_distribution, response_by_arm"}
